pages.quiz:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'J'ai un nez.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. She has long hair.
   B. I have a mouth.
   C. I have a nose.
   D. I have ten fingers.

2. Which little word goes with 'cadeau' (the a present)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. l'
   C. la
   D. le

3. Which is friendly weather? (1 mark)
   A. le soleil
   B. la neige et le vent fort
   C. l'orage
   D. l'inondation

4. What does 'Merci beaucoup !' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Thank you very much!
   B. I am ten years old.
   C. Happy birthday!
   D. There is a cake and there are balloons.

5. How do you say 'How do you spell it?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Ça s'écrit comment ?
   B. Ça va ?
   C. Et toi ?
   D. Je m'appelle Amina.

6. What does 'la main' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the leg
   B. the eyes
   C. the hand
   D. the nose

7. How do you say 'cheese' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le fromage
   B. les frites
   C. l'eau
   D. la banane

8. How do you say 'I dance' in French? (1 mark)
   A. je joue
   B. hier
   C. je danse
   D. je me repose

9. Which word needs a capital letter in a French sentence? (1 mark)
   A. salut in the middle of a sentence
   B. bonjour in the middle of a sentence
   C. merci in the middle of a sentence
   D. Amina

10. What does 'Il fait froid.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is cold.
   B. It is sunny.
   C. It is windy.
   D. It is hot.

11. What does 'la mangue' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. fish
   B. the tomato
   C. the orange
   D. the mango

12. Which little word goes with 'maison' (the house)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. le
   C. la
   D. l'

13. Which little word goes with 'chaise' (the chair)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. l'
   C. le
   D. la

14. What does 'Ma mère s'appelle Grace.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. My mother is called Grace.
   B. I have a brother and a sister.
   C. Who is it?
   D. This is my father.

15. How do you say 'When is your birthday?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai neuf ans.
   B. Ton anniversaire, c'est quand ?
   C. Bon anniversaire !
   D. Merci beaucoup !

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into English: 'Il fait froid.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

17. Write the French words for: the hand, the back, the stomach (3 marks) (3 marks)

18. Translate into French: 'The weather is nice.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

19. Translate into French: 'Happy birthday!' (2 marks) (2 marks)

20. Translate into French: 'She has black hair.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

21. Translate into French: 'I drink a juice.' (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — I have a nose.
   J'ai un nez. means I have a nose.

2. D — le
   cadeau is masculine, so we say le cadeau.

3. A — le soleil
   Sun is pleasant weather.

4. A — Thank you very much!
   Merci beaucoup ! means Thank you very much!

5. A — Ça s'écrit comment ?
   How do you spell it? in French is Ça s'écrit comment ?.

6. C — the hand
   la main means the hand.

7. A — le fromage
   cheese in French is le fromage.

8. C — je danse
   I dance in French is je danse.

9. D — Amina
   Names always begin with a capital letter.

10. A — It is cold.
   Il fait froid. means It is cold.

11. D — the mango
   la mangue means the mango.

12. C — la
   maison is feminine, so we say la maison.

13. D — la
   chaise is feminine, so we say la chaise.

14. A — My mother is called Grace.
   Ma mère s'appelle Grace. means My mother is called Grace.

15. B — Ton anniversaire, c'est quand ?
   When is your birthday? in French is Ton anniversaire, c'est quand ?

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is cold.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: la main, le dos, le ventre
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its accents and le or la.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: Il fait beau.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Bon anniversaire !
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: Elle a les cheveux noirs.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Je bois un jus.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.
